data.name: Rm_RM_POWER_PLAN
data.value: Switch the power plan to Balanced

data.name: Rm_RM_SERVICE_DISABLE
data.value: Stop the service and set it to Disabled

data.name: Rm_RM_DEFENDER
data.value: Turn on Defender real-time protection, update definitions, remove threats

data.name: Adv_ADV_DISK_SSD
data.value: An SSD makes booting and starting programs several times faster. Back up your files before replacing the disk.

data.name: Adv_ADV_DISK_HEALTH
data.value: The disk may be about to fail. Back up now and replace the disk. A reformat will not fix this.

data.name: Adv_ADV_DISK_FREE
data.value: Keep at least 15% of drive C: free. Start with Disk Cleanup, the Downloads folder, and the Recycle Bin.

data.name: Adv_ADV_RAM
data.value: 8 GB of memory or more is recommended.

data.name: Adv_ADV_CPU
data.value: Look at the top processes for programs that use a lot of CPU. If usage stays high even in normal use, the CPU itself is the limit.

data.name: Adv_ADV_MEM
data.value: Run fewer programs and browser tabs at once, or add memory.

data.name: Adv_ADV_DISK_IO
data.value: The disk stays busy. If it is an HDD, replacing it with an SSD helps the most.

data.name: Adv_ADV_EXT
data.value: Remove unknown extensions from the browser's extension page (chrome://extensions, edge://extensions). Deleting them from outside the browser can damage the profile.

data.name: Adv_ADV_UPDATE
data.value: Install updates from Windows Update in Settings.

data.name: Adv_ADV_REBOOT
data.value: Choose Restart from the Start menu. Shut down does not fully restart the PC because of Fast Startup.

data.name: Adv_ADV_DISK_CHECK
data.value: Disk errors have been logged. Back up, then consider a disk check (chkdsk) and replacing the disk.

data.name: Adv_ADV_POWER
data.value: Check the power cable and power strip, overheating (dust inside the case), and drivers.

data.name: Adv_ADV_AV_UPDATE
data.value: Open your antivirus program and update it.

data.name: Adv_ADV_PHOTOS
data.value: In Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Photos > Advanced options, try Repair, then Reset. If that does not help, uninstall Photos and reinstall it from the Microsoft Store. If the cause turns out to be the graphics driver or the antivirus, fix that first.

data.name: Adv_ADV_GPU_DRIVER
data.value: Download and install the latest driver from the graphics card maker (Intel, NVIDIA, AMD). If the screen also flickers, reconnect the cable, use a fixed refresh rate (60 Hz), and turn off variable refresh rate.

data.name: Adv_ADV_PERFCOUNTER
data.value: Run lodctr /R in an administrator command prompt and restart. If an optimizer program turned them off, undo that program's setting too.

data.name: Adv_ADV_CRASH_MODULE
data.value: Uninstall the program that owns the crashing module in Settings > Apps, or update it to the latest version.

data.name: Adv_ADV_KR_MODULES
data.value: Uninstall Korean banking and government security programs in Settings > Apps. Reinstall only the ones a site asks for, and remove them again when you are done.

data.name: Adv_ADV_AV_DUP
data.value: Use only one antivirus. Removing the ones you do not use makes the PC faster.
